---
name: Missing protocol or feature
about: A shell protocol (or a newer version of one) browl does not speak
labels: enhancement
---

**What is missing:** the protocol and version, or the request or event browl
does not expose.

**The shell component that needs it:** what it does without it. A real
application and compositor (with versions) is the most useful answer; it is
what decides which gaps get closed first.

**Who offers it:** compositors that implement it (sway, Hyprland, KWin,
mutter, ...), if you know.
